title: AI-Assisted Development: Work with Coding Agents & Review AI Code
concept: Use AI coding assistants and agents like an engineer: split work into small verifiable steps, give the agent the right context, make tests the contract, read every diff, check the packages and secrets an AI touches, review AI-generated pull requests by severity and know when vibe coding has to stop - each taught from a real change to a learning platform and graded with hidden tests.
description: An intermediate course for developers who already ship code and now work next to a coding agent. Every lesson starts from a change on the CodeDev learning platform - a bookmark feature an agent wrote in ten minutes, a test that can never fail, a package name that does not exist on the registry, an API key pasted into a prompt, a 300-line AI pull request with an SQL injection and a swallowed exception - and turns it into a habit you can check: spec first, small steps, context and instruction files, tests as the contract, diff reading, dependency and secret checks, an automated review checklist, the limits of vibe coding and an honest AI usage log. 12 lessons with quizzes on real diffs and logs and TypeScript challenges, including "Spot the AI Mistake" fixes. No real model is called.
